definitions.explanation: A system of government in which political parties compete for power and govern based on their platforms. The fundamental mechanism of modern parliamentary democracies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{政党|せいとう}{政治|せいじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: Party politics in Japan has a long history.

examples.japanese: {政党|せいとう}{政治|せいじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧⟦{不信感|ふしんかん}→不信感：16762_fushinkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まっている→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: Distrust toward party politics is growing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健全|けんぜん}→健全：11539_kenzen⟧な{政党|せいとう}{政治|せいじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: For healthy party politics, the role of opposition parties is also important.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧ (political party) and ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧ (politics; government). Refers to the system in which organized political parties play the central role in governance. Japan's modern party politics began in the Meiji era with the Freedom and People's Rights Movement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {政党|せいとう}{政治|せいじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧: development of party politics
- {政党|せいとう}{政治|せいじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧⟦{不信|ふしん}→不信：18313_fushin⟧: distrust of party politics
- ⟦{健全|けんぜん}→健全：11539_kenzen⟧な{政党|せいとう}{政治|せいじ}: healthy party politics
- {二大|にだい}{政党|せいとう}{政治|せいじ}: two-party politics

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧: parliamentary politics — focuses on the institution of parliament
- ⟦{民主|みんしゅ}→民主：06028_minshu⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧: democratic politics — broader concept of governance by the people
- ⟦{官僚|かんりょう}→官僚：02780_kanryou⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧: bureaucratic government — governance by unelected officials, often contrasted with party politics
